what: Every bet in Gamdom's public Crash bet feed for 44 hours, 26 to 28 October 2026, as the logged-out gamdom.com/crash page receives each finished round with its bets, stakes and cash-outs
recordedBy: ProvablyFair.org, recording the page's own round data for every round; game ids, hashes and crash points are in data/rounds-2026-10-26.csv
windowNote: window start and end are the start times of the first and last rounds (43.78 hours)
completeness: Gamdom numbers every Crash bet in sequence. The bets in this window carry 99,143 consecutive numbers; 99,119 of them are in the feed (data/bet-ids.json).

fields.game_id: the round the bet was placed in (all in data/rounds-2026-10-26.csv)
fields.player: rank of the player's stake total in this window (p1 = largest); names and Gamdom user ids removed
fields.stake_coins: the stake in Gamdom's coin unit, 1 coin = $1/1500 (data/units-2026-10-08.json)
fields.cashout: the multiplier the bet cashed out at; blank if the bet lost (the feed never shows a losing bet's target)

wallets.note: Players bet from wallets in several currencies; the feed gives every stake in Gamdom's coin unit. No stake in any wallet is below 15 coins ($0.01), and 15 is the smallest stake in 8 of the 13 wallets, the Turkish lira wallet included. For the crypto wallets the feed's wallet amount divided by the stake stays within a few percent within each currency, moving with the coin's price. So the coin amount is the stake's value whatever the wallet.
